recommendation: Keep this source fix. It completes the already-applied FHIR-40503 search parameter work while preserving the later FHIR-53301 hasPart split; no additional core change is recommended unless OO later chooses to add a separate DeviceDefinition device-identifier search code instead of the existing identifier coverage.
issue_request: FHIR-40503 was Applied as Persuasive with Modification for OO to review Device and DeviceDefinition search parameters. The accepted changes were to add Device version-type, rename Device udi-carrier to udi-carrier-hrf, and add DeviceDefinition search coverage for device identifiers, model-number, version, version-type, and has-part.
initial_application: FHIR-40503-tagged commits 55843e1232, c09b7267b8, cae8422ef9, and f187893e6a partially applied the request by adding the search parameters and adjusting Device version and DeviceDefinition model-number codes, but left mismatches in the DeviceDefinition UDI identifier expression, DeviceDefinition model-number id/url, and Device/DeviceDefinition version-type URLs.
additional_context: Device and DeviceDefinition are active resources in source/fhir.ini, so their bundle search parameter sources are in current build scope. Later Applied issue FHIR-53301 intentionally replaced the original DeviceDefinition has-part parameter with has-part-canonical and has-part-code after hasPart.reference became hasPart.definition[x]. FHIR-53212 later named DeviceDefinition-model-number and DeviceDefinition-version-type in normative prep, confirming the corrected naming. OO minutes on 2023-06-12 record the FHIR-40503 motion accepted per Jira, and a quoted Zulip search found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/devicedefinition/bundle-DeviceDefinition-search-params.xml so identifier indexes DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.deviceIdentifier, model-number has a matching SearchParameter id/url, and version-type has a matching canonical URL. Changed source/device/bundle-Device-search-params.xml so Device version-type also has a matching canonical URL.
source_changes: source/devicedefinition/bundle-DeviceDefinition-search-params.xml: renamed the model-number SearchParameter id/url from DeviceDefinition-model to DeviceDefinition-model-number.
source/devicedefinition/bundle-DeviceDefinition-search-params.xml: corrected the version-type canonical URL from DeviceDefinition-type-version to DeviceDefinition-version-type.
source/device/bundle-Device-search-params.xml: corrected the version-type canonical URL from Device-type-version to Device-version-type.

related_jiras.note: Later R6 normative prep names DeviceDefinition-model-number and DeviceDefinition-version-type, supporting the corrected SearchParameter id/url naming.
Later Applied issue replaced the original has-part parameter with has-part-canonical and has-part-code for hasPart.definition[x], so the reconciliation intentionally preserved the split.
Later UDI clarification confirms DeviceDefinition.udiDeviceIdentifier.deviceIdentifier is the DI value child relevant to identifier searching.
Later QA notes list DeviceDefinition search parameter information messages but do not supersede the FHIR-40503 corrections.
